summary.text: Mike Vondran is a Republican state representative from Iowa House District 94 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as CEO of TAG Communications.

paragraphs.text: Mike Vondran graduated from Hempstead High School in 1979.

His career experience includes working as CEO of TAG Communications, and he founded the HAVlife Foundation and has served as its director, on the advisory board of the Creative Arts Academy of the Quad Cities, and as president of the Great Mississippi Valley Fair.
Vondran lost the November 3, 2020 general election for Iowa House District 93 to incumbent Phyllis Thede.
He defeated Thede in the November 8, 2022 general election for District 94, succeeding Gary Mohr in the seat, and won re-election over Tracy Jones on November 5, 2024.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia shows him as chair of the Public Safety Committee and assigned to the House Commerce and House Ways and Means committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Karen Roebuck in the general election.
